description: ATA Carnet country check from the International Chamber of Commerce: whether a country runs the ATA Carnet system (duty-free temporary admission for samples, professional equipment and exhibition goods) and its national issuing and guaranteeing association with phone and website, as listed on ICC's 'ATA Carnet in your country' page. Individual carnet numbers cannot be verified publicly; the association answers that. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Country name or two-letter code, e.g. Türkiye, DE, United States
